lines: Ghane darakht ke neeche sula ke chhod gaya.
couplets.en: He laid me down to sleep beneath a thickly leafed tree and left.

lines: Ajeeb shakhs tha, sapne dikha ke chhod gaya.
couplets.en: Strange man, he gave me dreams and then left.

lines: Ye ujda ghar to usi ek ki nishani hai,
Vo apne naam ki takhti laga ke chhod gaya.
couplets.en: This desolate house is his keepsake, with his name still on the door.

lines: Tumhare shehar ka mausam bada suhana lage.
couplets.en: The weather in your city feels so lovely.

lines: Main ek shaam chura loon.
couplets.en: Let me steal an evening.

lines: Main ek shaam chura loon agar bura na lage,
Tumhare shehar ka mausam bada suhana lage.
couplets.en: If you don't mind, let me steal an evening in this lovely weather of yours.

lines: Jo doobna hai to itne sukoon se doobo.
couplets.en: If you must drown, do it quietly.

lines: Jo doobna hai to itne sukoon se doobo,
Ke aas-paas ki lehron ko bhi pata na lage.
couplets.en: If you must drown, do it so quietly that even the waves around you never know.

lines: Ke aas-paas ki lehron ko bhi pata na lage.
couplets.en: Let even the waves around you never know.

lines: Tumhare shehar ka mausam.

lines: Tumhare bas mein agar ho to bhool jao hamein.
couplets.en: Forget me if you can.

lines: Tumhare bas mein agar ho to bhool jao hamein,
Tumhein bhulane mein shayad hamein zamana lage.
couplets.en: Forget me if you can, for it may take me an age to forget you.

lines: Na jaane kya hai kisi ki udaas aankhon mein,

couplets.en: Who knows what lies in those sad eyes?

lines: Na jaane kya hai kisi ki udaas aankhon mein,
Vo munh chhupa ke bhi jaaye to bewafa na lage.
couplets.en: There's something in those sad eyes that makes even a face turned away seem faithful.

lines: Hamare pyaar se jalne lagi hai ye duniya,
